messages:
Sam (on-call): quick follow-up — thanks for the help last night. thinking we should schedule a short PIR to cover what tripped, customer impact, and actions. who can own coordinating?
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2035123421 — Sev2 DATABASE_THROTTLE triggered 2025-03-14T23:07Z. Affected customers: 12. Pages sent to @sam @kevin. Automated handoff to oncall on 2025-03-14T23:09Z.
Maria - SRE: +1. i'll volunteer to do the RCA writeup if someone runs the PIR session.
Kevin - Eng: i can run the session next week if that helps. prefer Tue/Thu mornings.
Olivia - PM: FYI ops told me 2 enterprise customers saw elevated latencies; CS reached out. I'll join to give customer context.
Jules (ops): we pushed a throttling patch at 23:40 that reduced errors. logs look like a hot path in cache-evict.
Nina - Support: logged all affected customer contacts in the incident doc: https://redwood.notion.site/incidents/2035123421
Sam (on-call): ok Kevin, can you be session lead? if yes, choose scribe too. i'll help collect action items.
Kevin - Eng: yep i can lead. volunteer scribe?
Maria - SRE: i'll scribe.
Kevin - Eng: awesome, thanks. propose three slots: 
```
1) Tue Mar 18 09:30-10:00 PT
2) Tue Mar 18 15:00-15:30 PT
3) Thu Mar 20 09:30-10:00 PT
```
please react with :one: :two: :three: or say if none work.
Olivia - PM: :one: works for me.
Jules (ops): :one: or :three:, leaning :three:.
Sam (on-call): :one: okay for me.
Nina - Support: :one: preferred.
Maria - SRE: :one: for scribe.
Kevin - Eng: great — looks like slot 1 wins. i'll create the calendar invite and attach the post-incident doc.
Kevin - Eng: calendar created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/2035123456-pir. invite includes agenda and pre-reads.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled — PIR invite created by @kevin. 3 attendees confirmed.
Olivia - PM: adding customer notes to the doc now.
Sam (on-call): action items before PIR: 
- collect timeline & logs (owner: Maria - SRE)
- impact spreadsheet for customers (owner: Nina - Support)
- deploy diff and patch notes (owner: Jules (ops))
- pre-read summary for customers (owner: Olivia - PM)
Kevin - Eng: can we agree to have pre-reads done 24h before meeting?
Maria - SRE: i'll have timeline & logs in the doc by Mon EOD.
Nina - Support: impact spreadsheet updated now.
Jules (ops): i'll paste the deploy diff and tests.
Olivia - PM: pre-read draft uploaded. pls comment.
Sam (on-call): thanks all. Kevin — do you want me to run the 'postmortem template' follow-through after the meeting?
Kevin - Eng: yes please. you can own the action tracker; i'll run the meeting and assign remediation owners.
Maria - SRE: quick note — tagging infra-notify and retention team in doc for follow-up.
Kevin - Eng: also, let's decide whether we escalate to Dedicated customers? Olivia can advise.
Olivia - PM: we'll review during the PIR; initial customer comms drafted.
Sam (on-call): final ask — if anyone else wants to attend / add pre-reads, drop them in thread. thanks :thumbsup: 
Kevin - Eng: see you Tue 09:30 PT.
